notes.title: Update Notes - 2024.10.15
notes.content:
Several small changes were made to improve the game including:

[list]
[*] Making the buttons visible in the menu after a level is completed (Victory Menu)
[*] Hiding the music volume control in the settings. No music is currently in the game and this confused players.
[*] Making improvements to how the list of languages is displayed. 
[/list]
